meta.notes: A thin week in Copenhagen: most new event and community roles were posted in Danish. The standout is Bevar Ukraine, a real community, partnerships and events role at an NGO, and DTU has a climate project role that starts exactly on 1 January. Boozt, LEGO and Reform have closed.

health.notes: Mostly engineering roles; TechBBQ coordinator role is unpaid

jobs.title: Youth Leadership Project Manager
jobs.notes: Community, partnerships and events in one role at an NGO: you run a leadership academy, a 40-speaker network, volunteers and partners across municipalities and companies, in English. Lead with the 33 volunteers and 20+ partners at Nordic Fintech Week plus your social entrepreneurship master. Gaps: they want a 1 December start (ask for January), some evening and weekend events, and NGO pay is likely under 40k.

jobs.title: Project Manager in the Climate and Energy Policy Division - DTU Management
jobs.notes: Climate impact, English, and it starts exactly on 1 January 2027 (2 year contract). You would run project meetings, consortium coordination and dissemination for EU projects. Honest gap: they ask for knowledge of energy systems and data handling, so lead with stakeholder coordination and multi-partner delivery. Deadline 6 November, 100+ clicks already.

jobs.title: Program Manager - Research Projects and Academic Administration
jobs.notes: Sofia option at a respected AI institute, working with researchers and external partners, and your Bulgarian is a real plus here. It leans on funding proposals and admin rather than events or community, so it is a stretch on the work you want.

jobs.title: People Experience & Events Project Lead
jobs.location: Remote or any Epassi office (listed in Helsinki)
jobs.notes: You would lead a 1,000+ person company event in March plus internal comms, and remote is allowed. Big gaps: fixed term to end of March 2027 at 3 to 4 days a week, immediate start, and it is an employee benefits platform. Only worth it as a short paid bridge.

jobs.title: Project Coordinator (Nordic - India)
jobs.notes: Dream company and the work fits (partner outreach for the Nordic India summit), but it is an unpaid long-term volunteer role at 5 to 20 hours a week. Shown so you know it exists; could be a way to get to know the TechBBQ team.
